description: A React component for managing and editing Google Maps location bounds for a restaurant, including polygon, radius, and point zones, with integration of GraphQL queries/mutations, autocomplete address search, and map interactions.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Updates Apollo cache with new restaurant profile data after mutation.

methods.name: onErrorFetchRestaurantProfile
methods.description: Handles errors during fetching restaurant profile, shows toast message.

methods.name: onRestaurantProfileFetchCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful fetch of restaurant profile, sets map center and marker.

methods.name: onErrorFetchRestaurantZoneInfo
methods.description: Handles errors during fetching zone info, shows toast message.

methods.name: onRestaurantZoneInfoFetchCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful fetch of zone info, sets map center, marker, and path.

methods.name: onErrorLocationZoneUpdate
methods.description: Handles errors during zone update mutation, shows toast.

methods.name: onRestaurantZoneUpdateCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful zone update, updates map and shows success toast.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Updates input value state for address search.

methods.name: onHandlerAutoCompleteSelectionChange
methods.description: Handles address selection from autocomplete, geocodes to get coordinates.

methods.name: onClickGoogleMaps
methods.description: Adds a point to the path when map is clicked in point mode.

methods.name: getPolygonPathFromCircle
methods.description: Generates polygon points approximating a circle based on center and radius.

methods.name: getPolygonPath
methods.description: Generates polygon points for a regular polygon (default 4 points) based on center and radius.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Updates polygon path and center when polygon vertices are edited.

methods.name: onLoadPolygon
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for polygon vertex edits.

methods.name: onUnmount
methods.description: Removes polygon event listeners on unmount.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Updates marker and center when marker is dragged, and updates polygon if in polygon mode.

methods.name: onLocationSubmitHandler
methods.description: Sends updated zone data to server via GraphQL mutation.
